'''Roberto''' is a male [[NPC]] working at the [[Averardo Vault (Instance)]]. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Roberto:''' Today's loss... Hmm, twenty-three crates. Cause: Discovered they were past their recommended usage date during inventory.
:'''Roberto:''' Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. Anything I can help you with?
:{{DIcon}} Crates? Are they used for transporting collectibles?
:'''Roberto:''' Yes. We have specially designed crates for transportation.
:'''Roberto:''' They're filled with thick paddling tailored to the size and shape of the item, keeping everything snug and secure.
:'''Roberto:''' This minimizes the risk of damage during shipping.
:'''Roberto:''' We regularly discard crates once they reach their recommended life span, just to be safe. Wouldn't want them to fall apart in transit!
:{{DIcon}} Fall apart? Has it ever happened before?
:'''Roberto:''' Well, I'm new here. I haven't seen anything like that firsthand, but from what I've heard... it's happened before.
:'''Roberto:''' I didn't think much about the whole "discarding crates" thing until [[Ludvika]] mentioned all the past accidents—
:'''Roberto:''' Everything from minor mishaps like drops to fires, robberies, and even [[Tacet Discord]] incursions.
:'''Roberto:''' The Vault has learned from these incidents over the years, and our procedures and have become much more stringent as a result.
:'''Roberto:''' I suppose I'm standing on the shoulders of those who came before me... but hey, better safe than sorry, right?
{{Dialogue End}}
